item.text: {"additional_concerns":["All six candidates declare TRUE_IS_SATISFIED but supply no evidence of performance: provider status alone or the existence of a request is unsupported as a sufficient condition for satisfaction.","The three request-based candidates also make a request necessary for a true result, although ownership records, operational compatibility and confirmation are not expressly conditional on a request.","Footnote 5 can be read as elaborating paragraph 14 with its demonstration trigger carried through, or as independently expressing demonstration without that condition; neither reading makes the request itself performance.","No SFC request does not establish fulfillment of underlying duties; under the inherited-trigger reading it leaves demonstration untriggered, while confirmation remains applicable.","Paragraphs 15 and 16 separately condition third-party audit or verification and a satisfactory legal opinion on SFC requests; those requests cannot automatically substitute for the paragraph 14 demonstration request.","Paragraph 10 and footnote 1 preserve ultimate responsibility despite outsourcing; allocation of authority, supervisory conduct and actual operational or record-keeping outcomes remain distinct matters requiring applicable standards and facts.","The register provisions, valuation-specific supervision provision and intermediary provisions do not establish performance of these Product Provider duties or justify importing their distinct actors and modal strengths without an applicability analysis.","Footnote 2, the complete requirements of paragraphs 10–13 and the referenced Appendix are not supplied; complete compliance and adequacy standards remain unresolved, and neither a numerical high-confidence
